'''R3-T6''', or '''Arthree-Teesix''', was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[R3-series astromech droid/Legends|R3-series astromech droid]] manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] and serving aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Compared to their [[R1-series astromech droid/Legends|R1]] and [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2]] predecessors, R3-series [[Droid/Legends|droids]] like R3-T6 possessed sophisticated circuitry and a larger memory, which increased their efficiency in [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] plotting. R3-T6 was present onboard the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and was subsequently [[Death/Legends|annihilated]] when the [[Battle station/Legends|station]] was destroyed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==Biography==
[[File:R3-T6-ANH.png|thumb|left|250px|R3-T6 on the Death Star during the Battle of Yavin]]
An [[R3-series astromech droid/Legends|R3-series astromech droid]], R3-T6, also designated Arthree-Teesix,<ref name="CCG" /> was manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]]<ref name="SWE" /> and in the service of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="CCG" /> where it was tasked with calculating [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] coordinates.<ref name="figure">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Saga Collection|pack=Astromech Droid Pack (Series 1)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TSCastroS1.asp}}</ref> By as late as [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="SWE" /> the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] was stationed aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]], a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] capable of obliterating entire [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. During the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], R3-T6 was roaming the corridors of the battlestation and was present when Imperial [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tanbris/Legends|Tanbris]] informed the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] that the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star's]] [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] were unable to track&mdash;and therefore destroy&mdash;the attacking [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="ANH" />

Despite the deployment of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] to deal with the threat, one Rebel [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]], [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], managed to launch a pair of [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] into the Death Star's [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|thermal exhaust port]]. The torpedoes reached the Death Star's [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]] and detonated, destroying the battlestation.<ref name="ANH" /> R3-T6 was destroyed in the explosion.<ref name="SWE" />

==Characteristics==
Like all R3-series astromech [[Droid/Legends|droids]], R3-T6 possessed an increased memory and superior circuitry compared to earlier models such as the [[R1-series astromech droid/Legends|R1]]<ref name="CCG" /> and [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2 astromech droids]].<ref name="SWE" /> These benefits gave R3-T6 increased efficiency in [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] plotting.<ref name="CCG" /> R3-T6 boasted a transparent dome and a [[Color/Legends|red-on-white]] color scheme on its body.<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
R3-T6 first appeared as an unidentified droid extra aboard the Death Star in [[1977]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], the first film of the [[original trilogy]].<ref name="ANH" /> The droid's scene was filmed on Stage 2 at [[Elstree Studios]] between [[June 17]] and [[June 28]], [[1976]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars]]''</ref> R3-T6 would be properly identified on the [http://www.starwarsccg.org/wiki/index.php?title=R3-T6_(Arthree-Teesix) "R3-T6 (Arthree-Teesix)" card] of the ''[[A New Hope Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]],<ref name="CCG" /> released in [[July]] of [[1996]].<ref name="Insider 31">{{InsiderCite|31|Pick a Card, Any Card: Making Movie Magic at Decipher, Inc.}}</ref>
